item.title: Calculating Classic, Rolling, and Full Retention in Python
item.description: In this post, I want to walk through how to manually calculate 3 types of Retention metrics using Python and Pandas, and how to plot a Retention curve using Matplotlib. Most of the time, a product manager would use an analytics platform for data and metrics analysis — but let’s imagine our PM has been stranded on a deserted island with nothing but a Python interpreter and a handful of libraries. That’s exactly what we’ll use.
